title: Genesis 6:15 — the ark is 300 x 50 x 30 cubits
summary: Genesis 6:15 in English giving the ark's length, breadth and height (three hundred, fifty and thirty cubits), summarised on the slide as 300 x 50 x 30 cubits.

text.text: 15 “This is how you shall make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, its breadth fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
